Name: Farm Buildings Revamped (Content Patcher)
Author: yuninocorn
Description:
[size=4][b]General[/b][/size]
This content pack utilizes Pathoschild's Content Patcher to alter the textures of your farm buildings. 
Most of the farm buildings are changed to a slightly more detailed/decorated version. I aimed to stay close to the vanilla style with my changes so everything can blend in with the environment without additional texture changes.

[size=4][b]Changes[/b][/size]
I did not alter the multiplayer cabins, fish pond, slime hutch and well due to their (in my opinion) already high level of detail. 
Every farm building (including the ones that I didn't revamp) is replaced with a snowy version during the winter.

The warp obelisks and the silo have been shortened to make them a little easier to implement in farm layouts.

[b][size=4]Configurations[/size][/b]
Using spachechase0's Generic Mod Config Menu, you can toggle the changes applied by this content pack without editing the mod files.

You can enable and disable the texture replacement for every building. 
You can also decide whether you want the affected buildings to change to their snowy version during the winter. If this option is set to false, the toggled buildings will keep their default alterations like in any other season. 
This may be beneficial if you are using mods that add custom farm buildings with no winter textures and you still want everything to look cohesive during that season.

[size=4][b]Installing[/b][/size]
Download the mod file and extract it to the 'Mods' folder in your Stardew Valley game folder. 

Enjoy!

Credit to FlashShifter for the original Stardew Valley Expanded farm buildings that I revamped in the optional version of this pack.
